result.title: SparseGDN: Chunk Sparse in Linear Attention
result.summary: Gated Delta Networks (GDNs) offer linear-time sequence modeling, yet long-context prefill remains costly due to dense intra-chunk computation, recurrent-state updates, and intermediate state storage. We introduce SparseGDN, a hardware-aware framework that combines structured intra-chunk approximation with input-dependent recurrent-event selection while producing outputs for every token. A block-adjacent solver reduces local Delta-solve computation, while a dynamic selector allocates recurrent-update budgets across head pairs. The GPU implementation materializes updates only for selected events and reconstructs token outputs using compact state snapshots and group-local interactions, reducing computation and memory traffic. We evaluate SparseGDN on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B across RULER tasks and context lengths from 4K to 128K. Retaining approximately 29% of recurrent events on average, SparseGDN achieves 1.50-1.94x GDN-core prefill speedups over native FLA kernels, including online selection overhead.

AI.brief_summary: SparseGDN 是面向 Gated DeltaNet 长上下文预填充的硬件感知加速框架，用块内结构化近似与输入相关的循环事件动态选择，减少局部 Delta 求解、循环状态更新与中间状态存储，在 Qwen3.5-4B/9B 的 RULER 任务上报告 1.50–1.94x 预填充加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 按输入动态分配循环状态更新预算、并以紧凑状态快照重建输出的做法，可能为 LVR 中「何时及多大程度更新 latent 状态」与状态压缩的内存–计算取舍提供借鉴线索，但该工作针对纯文本效率，与视觉推理的关联需核查。
